decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit has kept its own page for two years, a sign of continued commitment, and keeping a catalog equipment item costs little while it supports the firm's dental and hearing-lab customer base.

The orthopedic shoe last was launched only in 2024, so its prospects in the orthopedic market are still uncertain, and keeping this low-cost option open lets the firm learn more before committing further or abandoning it.

The post-curing unit is only mentioned on the website, which suggests limited commitment, but it complements the firm's additive and lab workflows at low holding cost, so the option is worth keeping while uncertainty resolves.
